name: Creality Falcon A1 - printed bed plate grid
notes: Coordinates are laser/canvas millimetres: x to the right, y downwards from the back of the machine.
Inner line positions were measured against an engraving-based calibration (laser ground truth).
Outer border positions are only starting values; the fit estimates them from the image ('free').
Remove the honeycomb panel and any material; close the lid before capturing.
